answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Reaching the jade of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A prism of per-task receipts records who did what, and the onyx of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
